title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-25 10:56:21 最新章节：第386章 追查魔宗余孽
content_zh:
在某个神秘的小岛上，有一家超级豪华的医院。高级特护病房的病床上，躺着一个三十多岁、超级帅气的年轻人。
这个年轻人就是让世界上各个势力、雇佣兵、杀手、黑手党都闻风丧胆的地狱首领——“阎王”
“地狱”组织那可是相当厉害，拥有世界上最强的雇佣兵和杀手，商业领域更是涉及到各行各业……
“阎王”这个名字，普通人可能不了解！但在各个国家的高层、大家族或者一些商业寡头中。
那可是无人不知，甚至是听到就脸色大变，生怕自己会有危险！
这是因为，“地狱”组织从不找普通人的麻烦！那些组织势力、大家族中“仗势欺人”的二代三代，才是“地狱”组织的重点关注对象。
除了“地狱组织”的10位高层，没人知道“地狱”首领“阎王”是谁，长啥样。
因为见过“阎王”真面目的人都已经去见另一个“阎王”了！
“阎王”本名叫“张昊宇”，从小就是个孤儿，被一个老头捡到并收养！
他没见过自己的父母，也没有其他亲人。张昊宇就和老头相依为命，从有记忆开始，老头就教他读书认字！
5岁的时候，张昊宇就跟着老头开始修炼“古武太极”。
可不是后世公园里，那些老人锻炼身体的那种太极，而是能打能杀的。
张昊宇8岁的时候，老头去找了小学校长，也不知道用了什么办法。
就让张昊宇直接参加考试，然后顺利拿到了小学毕业证！
接着，张昊宇还是跟着老头在家里学习初中课程。继续修炼“古武太极”。
10岁的时候，老头又去找了中学校长，张昊宇通过考试，成功拿到了初中毕业证。
张昊宇13岁那年，过完年一开学，老头就通过关系，让张昊宇参加考试，结果张昊宇顺利以插班生的身份进入高三读书。
这小子还挺争气，高考以优异的成绩被“国防大学”录取了！
张昊宇拿到录取通知书的时候，老头正在医院住院。
他兴高采烈地拿着通知书回到医院给老头看，老头那叫一个高兴啊！

然后，老头就把张昊宇的身世告诉了他！一个星期后，老人去世了。
好在有老头的老朋友们帮忙，和张昊宇一起，把老头的后事处理得妥当。
老头离世和自己身世的揭秘，对张昊宇打击可不小！不过这小子很坚强，这跟老头的教育有很大关系！
张昊宇一个人坐了两天火车，终于来到了国防大学！从那以后，他更加努力修炼，刻苦学习文化知识！
张昊宇16岁就进入了特殊部门，用两年时间凭本事当上了特战队的小队长。
执行过很多任务，立下了赫赫战功！就因为他太优秀了，被很多人给盯上了！
同时也被很多二代三代“羡慕，嫉妒，恨上了。”
在张昊宇20岁的那年，他执行任务时竟然被出卖了。
整个小队就只有“张昊宇”这个小队长活着被救了回来！
不过他也是“身负重伤”，在医院躺了一个多月才“醒过来”，用了半年多才康复出院。
张昊宇用了三个多月的时间，终于查出这次任务是被一个二代泄露给了敌对势力。
敌对势力多方联合，设下了埋伏，张昊宇的小队才会遭遇不测……
张昊宇把那个泄露信息的二代打成残废，二代的家族联合了几个家族一起发力。
找了个“无辜的人背锅”，把二代给洗脱了出来，还要“严惩”张昊宇的打人行为。
最后还是那位欣赏张昊宇的首长，动用了很多关系，才保住了张昊宇。
但是，张昊宇必须退伍离开部队！张昊宇离开部队后，偷偷地偷渡到了国外……
content_en:
On a mysterious island, there is a super luxurious hospital. Lying on the bed in the advanced intensive care unit was a super handsome young man in his thirties.
This young man is the leader of hell who makes all the forces, mercenaries, killers, and mafia in the world fearful - "King of Hell"
The "Hell" organization is quite powerful. It has the strongest mercenaries and killers in the world, and its business field involves all walks of life...
Ordinary people may not understand the name "King of Hell"! But among the top leaders, big families or some business oligarchs in various countries.
No one knows that, and even their expressions change drastically when they hear it, for fear that they will be in danger!
This is because the "Hell" organization never makes trouble for ordinary people! Those second and third generations of organized forces and big families who "bully others" are the key targets of the "Hell" organization.
Except for the 10 top executives of the "Hell Organization", no one knows who the leader of "Hell" "King of Hell" is and what he looks like.
Because everyone who has seen the true face of "King of Hell" has already gone to see another "King of Hell"!
The real name of "The King of Hell" is "Zhang Haoyu". He was an orphan since he was a child and was picked up and adopted by an old man!
He has never met his parents or other relatives. Zhang Haoyu and the old man depended on each other. Ever since he could remember, the old man taught him how to read and write!
When he was 5 years old, Zhang Haoyu started practicing "ancient martial arts Tai Chi" with his old man.
It's not the kind of Tai Chi that those old people used to exercise in parks in later generations, but something that can fight and kill.
When Zhang Haoyu was 8 years old, the old man went to the principal of the primary school, but he didn't know what method he used.
Let Zhang Haoyu take the exam directly and successfully get his primary school diploma!
Then, Zhang Haoyu followed the old man to study junior high school courses at home. Continue to practice "Ancient Martial Arts Tai Chi".
When he was 10 years old, the old man went to find the principal of the middle school again. Zhang Haoyu passed the exam and successfully obtained his junior high school diploma.
When Zhang Haoyu was 13 years old, as soon as school started after the Chinese New Year, the old man used his connections to let Zhang Haoyu take the exam. As a result, Zhang Haoyu successfully entered the senior year of high school as a transfer student.
This kid is quite impressive. He was admitted to the "National Defense University" with excellent results in the college entrance examination!
When Zhang Haoyu got the admission notice, the old man was in the hospital.
He happily returned to the hospital with the notice and showed it to the old man. The old man was so happy!
Then, the old man told him Zhang Haoyu's life experience! A week later, the old man died.
Fortunately, the old man's old friends helped, and together with Zhang Haoyu, the old man's funeral affairs were properly handled.
The death of the old man and the revelation of his life experience were a big blow to Zhang Haoyu! But this kid is very strong, which has a lot to do with the old man’s education!
Zhang Haoyu took the train alone for two days and finally arrived at the National Defense University! Since then, he has worked harder to cultivate and study cultural knowledge!
Zhang Haoyu entered the special department at the age of 16 and became the captain of the special team in two years based on his ability.
He has performed many missions and achieved great military exploits! Just because he is so good, he is targeted by many people!
At the same time, he was “envyed, envied, and hated by many second and third generations.”
When Zhang Haoyu was 20 years old, he was betrayed while performing a mission.
In the entire team, only the team leader "Zhang Haoyu" was rescued alive!
However, he was also "seriously injured" and lay in the hospital for more than a month before he "woke up". It took more than half a year to recover and be discharged.
It took Zhang Haoyu more than three months to finally find out that the mission was leaked to hostile forces by a second-generation man.
Many hostile forces unite and set up an ambush, and Zhang Haoyu's team will encounter unexpected events...
Zhang Haoyu crippled the second generation who leaked the information, and the second generation's family united several families to work together.
I found an "innocent person" to take the blame and put the second generationAfter being exonerated, Zhang Haoyu must be "severely punished" for his beating behavior.
In the end, it was the chief who admired Zhang Haoyu and used many connections to save Zhang Haoyu.
However, Zhang Haoyu must retire and leave the army! After Zhang Haoyu left the army, he secretly smuggled abroad...
